runRegenieStandardPipeline

Source: R/fct_connectAndRunGWASAnalysis.R
runRegenieStandardPipeline.Rd

Submit the Regenie unmodifiable standard pipeline via internal standard-pipelines API. Creates phenotype + description files locally, uploads them to SANDBOX_RED/CO2_temp//<run_tag>/ (using RED_BUCKET for gsutil), builds WDL-style input JSON referencing SANDBOX_RED paths, and submits the workflow. Users are allowed to add additional covariates using a dataframe of columns for each additional covariate.

runRegenieStandardPipeline(
  connection_sandboxAPI,
  cases_finngenids,
  controls_finngenids,
  phenotype_name,
  phenotype_description,
  covariates = NULL,
  extra_covariates_df = NULL,
  test = "additive",
  is_binary = TRUE,
  continue_with_finemap = TRUE,
  pipeline_name = NULL,
  release = "Regenie13",
  endpoint_path = "v2/standard-pipelines",
  timeout_sec = 300
)

Arguments

connection_sandboxAPI

List-like object containing base_url, token, conn_status_tibble

cases_finngenids

Character vector of FINNGENIDs for cases

controls_finngenids

Character vector of FINNGENIDs for controls

phenotype_name

Phenotype column name (must start with a letter; letters/numbers/_)

phenotype_description

Single string description written to phenodescription file (1 line)

covariates

Optional comma-separated covariate string of the standard FinnGen covariates will be used by default

extra_covariates_df

data.frame with FID/IID + extra covariate columns

test

Genetic model test string, Default: "additive"

is_binary

Logical TRUE/FALSE to specify binary or quantitative GWAS analysis type, Default: TRUE

continue_with_finemap

Logical TRUE/FALSE to specify whether to continue with fine mapping, Default: TRUE

pipeline_name

Optional pipeline name. If NULL, determined automatically from release.

release

Finngen data release version, Default: "Regenie13"

endpoint_path

internal API path, Default: "v2/standard-pipelines"

timeout_sec

httr timeout seconds, Default: 300

Value

list(status, http_status, workflow_id, content, temp_files, sandbox_paths_used, upload_logs)
